name: SHOWCASE | Invoice Chase | Execute Workflow → Approve and send one reminder | v1

parameters.content:
## SHOWCASE | Invoice Chase | Approve and send one reminder | v1 (W3 of 3, sub-workflow)
**Purpose:** one run per overdue invoice. Re-checks the invoice, writes the reminder from a template (no AI), asks the owner by email (Approve / Decline), re-checks again after the answer, and only then sends the reminder to the TEST address.
**Owner:** AI Ops Expert owner. **Trigger:** called by W2 (Execute Workflow Trigger). **Version:** v1. **Last change:** 2026-10-31. **n8n version built on:** PLACEHOLDER_N8N_VERSION_AND_EDITION (unknown). **Built INACTIVE. Synthetic data only.**
**Rule:** the only connection into the customer "Send reminder" node comes from the branch that is pending AND approved AND still unpaid AND unchanged. The customer's email is never used as a recipient in this showcase.
**AFTER IMPORT (owner):** (1) Import this workflow FIRST (W2 needs its ID). It must import with no errors. (2) Settings > Error Workflow = `SHARED | Error Alert | Error Trigger → Slack alert | v1` (file holds PLACEHOLDER_ERROR_ALERT_WORKFLOW_ID). (3) Timezone: file holds UTC as a safe default; set PLACEHOLDER_TIMEZONE. (4) Settings > "This workflow can be called by": restrict to W2 once W2 exists (wording: verify on import). (5) Do NOT set a Timeout Workflow here (may cancel waiting approvals). (6) Fill the PLACEHOLDER_ values in the Settings node. (7) On "Ask owner to approve" set Limit Wait Time = approval_wait_hours if the option exists (Gmail docs do not list it: verify). (8) Do not forward the approval email: each run has its own resume link.
**Verify on import:** every typeVersion and each node marked in its notes (design sections 9 and 17).

nodes.name: Write reminder from template

assignments.name: reminder_subject
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const ck = $('Check invoice now').first().json; const S = $('Settings').first().json; const map = { invoice_no: ck.invoice_no }; return String(S['subject_' + $('Start from daily scan').first().json.tier]).replace(/\[(invoice_no)\]/g, (m, k) => map[k]); })() }}

assignments.name: reminder_body
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const ck = $('Check invoice now').first().json; const S = $('Settings').first().json; const tier = $('Start from daily scan').first().json.tier; const map = { customer_name: ck.customer_name, invoice_no: ck.invoice_no, balance: (ck.balance_minor / 100).toFixed(2), currency: ck.currency, due_date: ck.due_date, days_past_due: String(ck.days_past_due) }; return String(S['body_' + tier]).replace(/\[(customer_name|invoice_no|balance|currency|due_date|days_past_due)\]/g, (m, k) => map[k]); })() }}

nodes.notes: Template text only, NO AI. Shows the remaining BALANCE (so partial payments show what is still owed), not the invoice amount. Plain text only. Recipient = demo_recipient, never the customer email. Verify on import: typeVersion is a builder assumption (n8n version UNKNOWN); take the version from the node panel on your instance. Fix pass: placeholders are filled in a single pass with a replacer function, so a customer name containing $&, $` or [invoice_no] is inserted as plain text and never interpreted.

parameters.subject: ={{ 'Approve reminder for invoice ' + $('Start from daily scan').first().json.invoice_no }}
parameters.message: ={{ (() => { const nl = String.fromCharCode(10); const esc = (s) => String(s ?? '').replace(/&/g, '&').replace(/</g, '<').replace(/>/g, '>').replace(/"/g, '"').replace(/'/g, '''); const ck = $('Check invoice now').first().json; const w = $('Write reminder from template').first().json; return esc('Send this reminder? (Do not forward this email.)' + nl + nl + 'Invoice: ' + ck.invoice_no + nl + 'Balance still owed: ' + (ck.balance_minor / 100).toFixed(2) + ' ' + ck.currency + nl + 'Days past due: ' + ck.days_past_due + nl + 'Level: ' + $('Start from daily scan').first().json.tier + nl + 'It would be sent to the TEST address: ' + w.reminder_to + nl + nl + 'Subject: ' + w.reminder_subject + nl + nl + w.reminder_body); })() }}

nodes.notes: Gmail "Send a message and wait for approval", Approve and Disapprove ("Decline"). Sent to the OWNER. Retry 2 may rarely put two approval emails in the inbox: harmless, the log row is re-checked after the answer. On final failure the log row stays pending and is swept later. Verify on import: sendAndWait parameter names (responseType, approvalOptions), typeVersion 2.1, whether Limit Wait Time exists (set it to approval_wait_hours, expression allowed?), the output field name (expected data.approved), how Decline differs from timeout, and T42 (previewing the email must not count as Approve). Fix pass: the whole approval text (including the customer name) is HTML-escaped (& < > quote) because this text is shown inside an HTML page; the plain-text reminder itself is not changed.

nodes.name: Still pending and not expired? (false = end, no write)

conditions.leftValue: ={{ (() => { const r = $('Re-read log row').first().json; const S = $('Settings').first().json; const cut = $now.minus({ hours: Number(S.approval_wait_hours) + 2 }); const at = DateTime.fromISO(String(r.claimed_at ?? '')); return String(r.status ?? '').trim() === 'pending' && at.isValid && !(at < cut); })() }}

nodes.notes: EXPIRY GUARD. TRUE = open. FALSE = closed (already timed_out by the sweep, or anything else): end with NO write, so a late Decline can never overwrite timed_out and a late Approve sends nothing. Same cut-off as the W2 sweep (wait hours + 2). Output 1 (true) and output 2 (false) are described in the node name/notes.
